sessions.name: Session A
messages: Hi, I'm starting a new project called Project X, it's a task manager app.
I'm building Project X in Python with FastAPI.
We decided to use PostgreSQL for the database.

The deadline for Project X moved to November 15.
I use Go for Project X.

I changed my mind, I prefer detailed explanations.
